baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional willing, emphatic taking-away, and what was revealed to you.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine willing governs both disclosure and its continued availability: a source-originating, hidden conveyance can be carried out of the recipient's reach, so receipt never becomes independent possession.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing supplies the source-side volition that keeps the communicated object contingent.
Going and passing supply the motion of carrying the disclosed content out of the recipient's reach.
Hidden conveyance of knowledge supplies the delivery mode whose availability, not merely a physical copy, can cease.

changed_reading.before: The verse threatens removal of a text already possessed by its recipient.
changed_reading.after: The source can revoke access to its own continuing conveyance; revelation is received but never possessed independently of that source.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Then you would find no wakil for it, for yourself, against Us.
baseline_models.mechanism: The aftermath forms a custodial and representative scene: searching fails because no delegated keeper can retain, recover, or guarantee the revelation over against its revealer.

activation_trace.role: Finding or attaining a sought thing supplies the failed search for an effective representative after withdrawal.
Entrusting an affair to another supplies the legal delegation that the recipient cannot establish against the source.
A keeper sufficient to preserve an entrusted affair supplies the unavailable office of retention or recovery.

changed_reading.before: After the loss, no generic helper would offer consolation or replacement.
changed_reading.after: No delegate, guarantor, or keeper can establish a claim over the revelation against its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The requested authority and aid in 17:80 come from the divine source, while 17:86 denies a representative against that source. Legitimate support is delegated downward; it cannot become counter-sovereign leverage.

activation_trace.role: Delegation supplies the focus verse's impossible attempt to authorize representation against the authorizing source.
Authority and jurisdiction supply the source-granted competence requested before the focus warning.
Aid that makes its recipient prevail supplies the valid form of support when it comes from the source.

structural_cues: 17:80 grammatically locates its requested supporting authority at the divine source; its branchless ل د ن cue is structural only.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies source-derived authority and aid, then denies a delegate against that source; I infer a one-way authorization relation. A live alternative is that the two helpers address unrelated dangers.

changed_reading.before: The passage first promises support and later withdraws all support.
changed_reading.after: Support remains possible as a grant from God, but no granted office can be converted into leverage against God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth arrives while falsehood goes until its trace is cut off; then the focus says the revealed vehicle can also go. The contrast separates truth's reality from the local availability of its disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Passing away supplies the possible departure of the revealed disclosure from this recipient setting.
Arrival and obtainment supply truth's incoming motion before the focus warning.
Reality-matching stability supplies the truth whose status need not vanish with its local carrier.
Departure until no trace remains supplies the contrasting extinction assigned to falsehood.

structural_cues: 17:81 coordinates truth's arrival with falsehood's departure and repeats departure as falsehood's disposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two kinds of going; I infer that the focus threatens access to truth rather than truth's truth-status. A live alternative is that 17:86 speaks only about the experienced content and leaves that distinction unstated.

changed_reading.before: Taking the revelation away would amount to truth itself becoming void.
changed_reading.after: The disclosed carrier can depart without truth becoming false; what is revocable is local access to disclosure, not reality's correspondence to truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: What is delivered from the Qur'an operates as healing and mercy, yet damaged reception increases loss. Withdrawal therefore removes an active therapeutic channel, not neutral information, and its stakes differ by recipient relation.

activation_trace.role: A hidden delivery of knowledge supplies the focus object whose operative access can be removed.
Sending down and delivering supplies the incoming channel through which the Qur'anic material becomes available.
Healing and restoration supply the beneficial work performed by the delivered material.
Merciful tenderness supplies the beneficial relation in which continued revelation operates.
General diminution supplies the opposite outcome produced when reception compounds loss.

structural_cues: 17:82 predicates healing and mercy of what is sent down from the Qur'an, while the same delivery increases loss for wrongdoers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery and opposed effects; I infer that removal withdraws an operative treatment rather than only data. Alternatively, the medical language may characterize effects without defining what removal would target.

changed_reading.before: The hypothetical loss is chiefly a reduction in available information.
changed_reading.after: The hypothetical loss closes a living channel of healing and mercy, while also ending the exposure through which resistant reception had increased loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 17:83 the human receives good, turns a side away, and creates distance; in 17:86 the giver can make revelation go away. The reversed direction turns withdrawal into a relational mirror of human distancing from gift.

activation_trace.role: Going away supplies the source-controlled removal that reverses the preceding human motion.
A good and eased condition supplies the prior gift from which the human distances himself.
Turning one's side away supplies the recipient's first motion of relational withdrawal.
Moving one's side to a distance supplies the spatial pattern mirrored by possible divine removal.

structural_cues: 17:83 places reception of good, bodily turning, and distance in one sequence only three ayat before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent but opposite withdrawal motions; I infer a rhetorical reversal, not a causal rule that human turning triggers removal. The live alternative is an independent warning about divine power.

changed_reading.before: The threat is an arbitrary display of power unrelated to recipient posture.
changed_reading.after: The threat can expose a reversal: the recipient who distances himself from gift remains dependent on a giver able to distance the gift from him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge is given and explicitly little in 17:85; continued preservation after the removal warning is named mercy and a great favor in 17:87. Revelation is thus an epistemic surplus sustained by generosity, not an acquired entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Source-side willing supplies the contingency against which gift and mercy are measured.
Giving supplies the bestowed rather than self-produced character of the recipients' knowledge.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic field whose human share is bounded.
Smallness and paucity supply the explicit limit on the recipients' epistemic holding.
Merciful tenderness supplies the exception under which the revelation remains available.
Benefaction and gift supply the positive account of continued preservation after the threat.

structural_cues: 17:85 limits what recipients were given; 17:87 immediately continues the removal sentence with an exception and calls the favor great.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited gift before the warning and mercy after it; I infer that continued revelation is the mercy preserving a revocable grant. A live alternative narrows 17:87's mercy specifically to the addressee's preservation.

changed_reading.before: Possession of revelation creates a settled epistemic entitlement interrupted only by a threat.
changed_reading.after: Even the recipient's knowledge is a limited allotment, and the revelation's continued presence is surplus mercy rather than entitlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: All humans and jinn may assemble and back one another yet cannot bring a likeness of this Qur'an. The absent wakil is therefore not merely a protector after loss; no coalition can function as a replacement producer.

activation_trace.role: A sufficient keeper supplies the unavailable agent who might preserve or replace what is withdrawn.
Coalition on a shared undertaking supplies the maximum collective attempt to answer the loss.
A matching counterpart supplies the exact replacement that the coalition cannot produce.
Back-strength and assistance supply the mutual support that still fails to generate a counterpart.

structural_cues: 17:88 follows the mercy clause and tests the combined productive capacity of both human and jinn communities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed imitation under maximal coalition; I infer that this specifies why no wakil can answer withdrawal. Alternatively, the imitation challenge may establish authorship without describing recovery after loss.

changed_reading.before: A helper might be absent even though another community could reconstruct equivalent content.
changed_reading.after: Withdrawal is irreparable because even universally pooled agency and mutual backing cannot manufacture a counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later demands move from a gushing spring to gold and finally to a written object they can read. Against that escalation, 17:86 distinguishes hidden, source-governed disclosure from a material sign that claimants can demand, inspect, and control.

activation_trace.role: Source-side willing supplies the control over revelation that the challengers' conditions attempt to relocate.
Hidden conveyance supplies the non-spectacular communication already given before material proofs are demanded.
Writing and inscription supply a latent visible medium sharpened by the later demand for a readable written object.
Water springing from an eye supplies the first demanded, controllable material outflow.
Gold as ornament supplies the demanded conversion of authority into visible wealth.
Ordered letters and a written object supply the inspectable artifact demanded in place of mediated disclosure.
Reading and recitation supply the challengers' insistence on an object available on their terms.

structural_cues: 17:90-93 repeat belief conditions and escalate from terrestrial production through celestial spectacle to a personally readable writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escalating conditional demands after a source-controlled withdrawal warning; I infer a contest over who sets the medium and terms of disclosure. A live alternative treats the demands only as examples of refusal, without linking them to 17:86's modality.

changed_reading.before: The focus threat belongs to the same economy in which revelation is one sign-object among other producible proofs.
changed_reading.after: The focus refuses claimant control of the sign economy: revelation remains source-governed communication that can be withdrawn rather than forced into spectacle or commodity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close names God sufficient as witness between messenger and audience. Thus the focus does not leave revelation in an unwitnessed vacuum; it denies a counter-delegate precisely where the source's own witnessing is sufficient.

activation_trace.role: A keeper sufficient for an entrusted matter supplies the counter-office that cannot be found against God.
Standing over an affair until sufficiency is achieved supplies God's adequate handling of the evidentiary relation.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the witness that remains when no counter-agent can be appointed.

structural_cues: 17:96 places the sufficient witness between messenger and audience and closes with divine knowledge and sight of servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an absent counter-keeper and a sufficient divine witness; I infer an asymmetric evidentiary closure. A live alternative reads 17:96 only as a separate attestation of the messenger.

changed_reading.before: No wakil means abandonment with no competent witness or custodian anywhere.
changed_reading.after: There is no representative against the source, but the communication is not unwitnessed: the source's own sufficient testimony closes external appeal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the gold branch inside the focus root for going through 17:93's explicit gold branch. It remains packet-anchored as a cross-domain value echo, but downstream prose must mark it as anti-ornamental resonance, never as the lexical meaning of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic verb of taking away carries a packet branch for gold alongside its ordinary motion branch.

activation_trace.role: Gold metal supplies a branch-distant image of precious substance latent in the focus verb's root.
Gold ornament supplies the explicit activator that turns the latent precious-metal image into an anti-display contrast.

changed_reading.before: The threatened object and the demanded gold house occupy unrelated value registers.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the gold-house demand throws the true precious grant into relief: visible ornament can be demanded, but revelation's value remains source-given and revocable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ج د د mapping under the focus root و ج د and a material water image. It remains valid as a packet-backed echo activated by the demanded spring and rivers, but downstream prose must present it only as a depletion analogy, never as the lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The failed finding after withdrawal carries a packet-mapped branch of water or milk becoming cut off.

activation_trace.role: Water or milk drying up supplies the branch-distant depletion image attached to the focus act of finding.
Water welling from a spring supplies the first explicit flow image that activates the focus-side depletion branch.
A river cutting the earth with flowing water extends the demanded abundance against which drying becomes legible.

changed_reading.before: After removal, no helper can be located.
changed_reading.after: Against the demanded gushing waters, withdrawal can be imagined as a source gone dry: no counter-agent can make the withdrawn disclosure flow again.

strongest_changes: Continued revelation reads as revocable mercy and favor, not recipient-owned epistemic stock.
Authority can aid only when granted from the source; it cannot become representation against the source.
The failed imitation challenge makes withdrawal irreparable because collective backing cannot manufacture a counterpart.
The material-sign demands expose a contest between source-governed disclosure and claimant-controlled spectacle.
summary.what_was_special: The trace links opposite movements of distancing, separates truth's reality from access to its disclosure, and preserves two contained branch-distant echoes: gold against ornament and a dried source against demanded waters.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact mode of taking away remains open: memory, inscription, recited practice, intelligibility, and access are all live.
The mercy exception may describe preservation of the revelation broadly or the addressee's preservation more specifically.
The gold and dried-source activations are packet-resolvable but should remain exploratory echoes rather than lexical claims.
